title: The Angel Gabriel Visits Mary
description: The angel Gabriel is sent to Nazareth and tells the virgin Mary that she will give birth to God's Son, Jesus, by the power of the Holy Spirit.

versions.title: The Angel Gabriel Visits Mary
versions.description: The angel Gabriel brings Mary the message that she will give birth to God's Son, Jesus.
versions.reason: [major] references: The proposal combines two different narratives: the annunciation to Mary (Luke 1:26-38) and the angel's message to Joseph (Matthew 1:18-25). These are two distinct stories with different main characters and should be treated separately. The title and description concern only Mary's annunciation.
